baseline.question: How many customers are there?

baseline.question: How many orders were cancelled?

baseline.question: How many completed orders are there?
baseline.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

baseline.question: What is the total revenue from completed orders?
baseline.sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

baseline.question: Which customer has placed the most completed orders?
baseline.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY COUNT(o.order_id) DESC LIMIT 1

baseline.question: Which customer has spent the most money in total?
baseline.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

baseline.question: Show the top 3 customers by total amount spent.

baseline.question: Give me the top customer by number of orders.

baseline.question: List the dates of the 5 most recent completed orders.

baseline.question: What is the name of the customer who signed up most recently?

hybrid.question: Which customer has placed the most completed orders?
